feature_sets.coordinate_pair: both breakpoint reference coordinates and node lengths; no graph or nucleotide input
feature_sets.sequence_kmer_pair: both breakpoint mono/di/tri-nucleotide composition; no graph adjacency
feature_sets.frozen_pangenomefm_pair: both frozen topology-pretrained breakpoint embeddings; current encoder has no nucleotide input
feature_sets.coordinate_plus_sequence_kmer_pair: C+S: coordinate and sequence-composition features; no topology embedding
feature_sets.coordinate_plus_frozen_pangenomefm_pair: C+T: coordinate and frozen topology embedding; no nucleotide input
feature_sets.sequence_plus_frozen_pangenomefm_pair: S+T: sequence composition and frozen topology embedding
feature_sets.coordinate_plus_sequence_plus_frozen_pan: C+S+T: coordinate, sequence composition, and frozen topology embedding
feature_sets.frozen_sequence_fm_pair: S-FM: frozen pretrained sequence-model embedding only; no graph adjacency
feature_sets.coordinate_plus_frozen_sequence_fm_pair: C+S-FM: coordinate and frozen sequence-model embedding
feature_sets.frozen_sequence_fm_plus_frozen_pangenome: S-FM+T: frozen sequence-model and topology embeddings
feature_sets.coordinate_plus_frozen_sequence_fm_plus_: C+S-FM+T: coordinate, frozen sequence-model, and topology embeddings
feature_sets.topology_control_pair: H: handcrafted label-free local topology statistics only
feature_sets.coordinate_plus_topology_control_pair: C+H: coordinate and handcrafted topology statistics
feature_sets.coordinate_plus_sequence_kmer_plus_topol: C+S+H: coordinate, sequence composition, handcrafted topology
C+S+H+T: adds frozen PangenomeFM beyond handcrafted topology
feature_sets.coordinate_plus_frozen_sequence_fm_plus_: C+S-FM+H: coordinate, frozen sequence model, handcrafted topology
C+S-FM+H+T: adds frozen PangenomeFM beyond handcrafted topology
feature_sets.graph_pair: both breakpoint node degrees; no coordinates or nucleotide input
feature_sets.training_prevalence: constant insertion prevalence estimated from downstream training chromosomes
feature_sets.random_uniform: seeded U(0,1) score independent of all inputs

target: insertion versus deletion among versioned SV records of length >=50 bp
fairness_policy: all feature sets use identical mapped variants and chromosome splits
calibration_policy: temperature and F1 threshold fit on validation chromosomes only
upstream_leakage_control: checkpoint pretraining excluded every downstream test chromosome
important_limitation: variant records are graph-derived/assembly-derived truth, not a donor-held-out molecular phenotype

external_sequence_cache_audit.target_selection_note: target caches contribute segid arrays only; no label or split array is read

canonical_conflict_interpretation: all representations of a conflicting canonical identity are excluded before frozen embedding extraction; remaining same-label equivalents are collapsed
